statement: Suppose that $x+\frac{1}{x}=k$, where $x\neq 0$. (i) Show that $x^{3}+\frac{1}{x^{3}}=k^{3}-3k$. (ii) Hence find the value of $x^{3}+\frac{1}{x^{3}}$ when $k=2$. (iii) Deduce the value of $x^{6}+\frac{1}{x^{6}}$ when $k=2$.
hints: Square the result to reach the sixth-power sum.
